name: network.scan
description: Scan the local network using ARP + port probing. Discovers hosts, checks SSH (port 22), and detects running Jait gateway nodes. Returns a summary of discovered hosts.

subnet.description: Target subnet prefix (e.g. "192.168.1"). If omitted, auto-detects from local interfaces.

deep.description: Whether to run a deeper sweep across the full subnet instead of relying mostly on ARP/neighbour cache. Defaults to true.

includeIps.description: Specific IPs to force-include in the scan, for example ["192.168.1.100"].
